usereventscript.name: SUST - Item Receipt to Settlement
usereventscript.description: Auto-creates settlement record from Item Receipt for the Sustana Recovery subsidiary (subsidiary ID configurable via script parameter — v2)

scriptcustomfield.description: Internal ID of the Sustana Recovery subsidiary in this NetSuite account. Set this on the deployment to enable the auto-settlement automation.
scriptcustomfield.help: Required. Set to the Sustana Recovery subsidiary's internal ID (e.g., 7 in the demo account). If unset, the script logs an error and skips processing.
scriptcustomfield.label: Sustana Recovery Subsidiary ID
